specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** reusability-metrics-scorer
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Apply
**Bloom Verb:** apply
**Learning Objective:** The learner will apply the ten open license checks, the ten modularity checks, and the ten metadata checks, with the Chapter 3 scoring rules, to choose the metric score for each of nine cases, with at least 8 of 9 scores exactly correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** The Open License Metric, The Modularity Metric, The Metadata Metric, Metric Score, Scoring Descriptor (all defined in this chapter or in Chapter 3 above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each case the learner chooses a whole-number score from 0 to 10 after seeing the ten check results. A score is correct when it equals the Correct score column in Content. Mastery is at least 8 of 9 scores correct on the first attempt. Opening the check lists and the descriptor table is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) The three metrics use different scoring rules. (2) A serious failure always drops a full band. (3) Full completeness of the six fields earns a 10. **Instructional Rationale:** Applying a scoring procedure to new cases is an Apply-level task. Nine cases across three check lists make the learner run the same procedure on different lists, with different serious checks. **Content:** The three ten-check lists are those in the chapter sections "The Open License Metric", "The Modularity Metric", and "Scoring the Three Reusability Metrics", each marked serious or not. The descriptor bands applied to the share of checks passed: 0% is 0; 1% to 24% is 1 to 2; 25% to 49% is 3 to 4; 50% to 74% is 5 to 6; 75% to 89% is 7 to 8; 90% to 100% is 9 to 10. Within a two-number band, choose the lower number when a serious check failed and the higher number otherwise. A score of 10 requires every check to pass. The nine cases: | # | Metric | Resource | Checks failed | Checks passed | Share | Band | Serious failure? | Correct score | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Open license | Open Algebra | None | 10 | 100% | 9 to 10 | No | 10 | Every check passed. | | 2 | Open license | Watershed Basics | 8 | 9 | 90% | 9 to 10 | Yes, check 8 | 9 | A failed check means the score is 9, and the failure is serious. | | 3 | Open license | Mixed Rights Packet | 2, 3, 6, 8, 9 | 5 (checks 1, 4, 5, 7, 10) | 50% | 5 to 6 | Yes, check 8 | 5 | A serious failure puts the score at the lower number. | | 4 | Modularity | Open Algebra | None | 10 | 100% | 9 to 10 | No | 10 | Every check passed. | | 5 | Modularity | Watershed Basics | 2, 4, 7, 8, 9 | 5 | 50% | 5 to 6 | Yes, check 2 | 5 | Components with no address of their own is serious, so the lower number applies. | | 6 | Modularity | Single Long Page | 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10 | 3 (checks 4, 6, 7) | 30% | 3 to 4 | Yes, checks 1 and 2 | 3 | The page cannot be taken apart, which is serious, so the lower number applies. | | 7 | Metadata | Open Algebra | None | 10 | 100% | 9 to 10 | No | 10 | Every check passed. | | 8 | Metadata | Watershed Basics | 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10 | 4 | 40% | 3 to 4 | No | 4 | The title and author are present, so no serious check failed and the higher number applies. | | 9 | Metadata | Untitled Files | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10 | 1 (check 8) | 10% | 1 to 2 | Yes, checks 1 and 2 | 1 | The files have no title or author, which is serious, so the lower number applies. | **Provenance:** The ten-check lists and the bands follow this chapter and Chapter 3. The nine cases are illustrative cases written for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". Cases 2, 5, and 8 are the chapter's worked examples. **Rules:** A score is the band chosen from the share passed, and then the number chosen within the band by the serious-failure rule. A band of 9 to 10 gives 10 only when every check passes. Each case has exactly one correct score. **Learner Activity:** 1. The sim shows case 1 with its ten check results and the name of the metric. 2. The learner may open the check list and the descriptor table. 3. The learner chooses a score from 0 to 10, and the choice is committed. 4. The sim shows the count of passes, the band, whether a serious check failed, and the correct score with the Why text. 5. After case 9 the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 9 cases in the fixed order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [score]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. [passes] checks passed, which is [share] and the [band] band. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 9 correct on the first attempt". At 8 or more it adds "You can score all three reusability metrics." Below 8 it lists the Why text of each missed case. **Starting State:** Case 1 with all ten results shown and no score chosen. The question shown is "What open license score does this resource earn?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's worked examples score Watershed Basics 9 on open license, 5 on modularity, and 4 on metadata, each with the failed checks named in the chapter.
